Since I value goods equally but prefer variety and currently have the least of A and B, this exchange keeps total quantity the same while making my bundle less balanced overall. However, because A and B start equally scarce and the trade simply swaps one scarce good for another, my utility is effectively unchanged rather than improved, so I should not accept unless it increases utility. Therefore I reject this offer.
